title: Explain why the durable session projection mutates messages by index
outcome: The persisted-session projection documents the copy-on-write reason for indexed mutation so routine iteration refactoring does not detach every retained body.
acceptance: A concise source comment beside serialize_persisted_session_view's indexed loop explains that iter_mut would detach every retained message body whereas indexed mutation copies only pending causal-control messages; no product behavior changes.
